newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran GDP growth rises to 5.2 pct in year to Mar 97.
newsitem.headline: Iran GDP growth rises to 5.2 pct in year to Mar 97.

text.p: Iran's central bank governor said on Tuesday the country's GDP growth rate had risen to 5.2 percent in the Iranian year to March 1997 from 4.5 percent the previous year, an evening newspaper said.

"The growth rate figures for the industrial and mining sector were 5.7 (for the year to March 1996) and 6.3 percent (for the year to March 1997), while in agriculture, due to droughts in recent years, figures were 3.7 and 3.5 percent respectively," Mohsen Nourbakhsh said in remarks carried by Ettelaat daily.

The governor, who was speaking at a seminar on monetary and exchange policies, also said Iran's imports were valued at 16.5 billion rials in the year to March 1997, up from 12.6 billion rials in the year-ago period.
